fields.label: Description
fields.note: optional - Create does not require it

fields.label: Instructions
fields.note: required - Create stays disabled without it, even with Name filled

actions.name: Disable | Enable
actions.state: checked=enabled (name 'Disable'); unchecked=disabled (name 'Enable') - accessible name flips with state

modals.title: Create Subagent
modals.description: Give this helper a clear name and explicit instructions — the agent will route relevant requests here.
notes: Create disabled until BOTH Name and Instructions are filled (confirmed live: Name-only leaves it disabled, unlike the Projects module where Name alone suffices) - Description is optional.
On submit: subagent appears in the list immediately (enabled by default).

modals.title: Edit Subagent
modals.description: Give this helper a clear name and explicit instructions — the agent will route relevant requests here.
notes: Same field set and layout as Create, prefilled with the subagent's current Name/Description/Instructions.

modals.title: Subagent Details
modals.description: See what this helper does and change how it works anytime
notes: Shows subagent icon/name and a status pill ('Active').
Four stat blocks: Today (N runs), This week (N runs), All time (N runs), Success rate (— no runs yet, for a fresh subagent).

'Recent activity' section: heading + 'Nothing yet' tag when empty, plus empty-state copy 'No activity yet' / 'When your main assistant hands a task to this helper, it'll show up here with the result and the time it happened.'

modals.title: Delete <subagent name>?
modals.description: This will permanently remove this subagent. This can't be undone.
notes: No soft-delete/undo - 'Yes, delete' is immediate and permanent per the dialog copy.
